label: Real SERV plan, Sep 24
note: Response from POST /api/plan against live SERV and live IXS. Vault is the IXS vault state at that time.

inputs.rules: Never be short for payroll. Keep 3 days of agent spend liquid. Park the rest, but keep at least 50% of the balance liquid.

reasons.text: Keep 81600 USDC liquid to cover the 42000 payroll due October 1, all 36000 of agent spend, and 3600 for the required three-day buffer.
reasons.rule: "Never be short for payroll. Keep 3 days of agent spend liquid."

reasons.text: Keep the additional 3600 USDC buffer beyond payout funds, equal to three days at 1200 USDC per day.
reasons.rule: "Keep 3 extra days of daily spend liquid on top of the payouts liquid funds."

reasons.text: Park 46800 USDC, the full amount remaining after liquid funds; this is below the 60% parking cap and leaves more than 50% of the balance liquid.
reasons.rule: "Park at most 60% of balance. Keep at least 50% of the balance liquid."

reasons.text: Use the listed sync vault because it accepts deposits; request 42000 USDC on October 14 so it is available before the October 15 payroll.
reasons.rule: "Park only in vaults where acceptsDeposits is true"; "A sync vault (lagDays 0) can be redeemed the day before a payout."

reasons.text: Liquid funds plus parked funds equal the 128400 USDC balance.
reasons.rule: "liquid + total parked equals the balance exactly."
